 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Devnarayan Mishra

 At Jabalpur

sentences.text:
On The 8 th Of January, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 50098 of 2024
 Raj
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
Appearance:
Shri Sanjeev Kumar Tiwari -Advocate for applicant.

Shri Ajeet Rawat -Government Advocate for respondent/State.
 ORDER Case diary produced.

This is first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Section 439 of Cr.P.C.) in connection with Crime No.133/2024, Police Station Shahpur, District Burhanpur (M.P) registered under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(Ch), 376(3)
of IPC and section 5(L)N, read with section 6 of POCSO Act.
Applicant is in custody since 03.07.2024.

2. Learned counsel for applicant has submitted that the victim has not supported the prosecution case in her statement recorded under section 164 of Cr.P.C and she has alleged that her grand father,
who lodged report in this case was trying to molest her violated her privacy.
On that ground, she left the guardianship of her maternal grand father.
Her parents are dull witted, that is why she was living with her maternal grand father.
The applicant is her relative and on her own she went along with him.
Hence the applicant may be released on bail.

3. Learned counsel for the State has submitted that as per school record NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:678 2 MCRC-50098-2024 the victim is a minor and under 15 years of age,
therefore, the bail application be dismissed.
4. Heard the parties and I have gone through the case diary.
Looking to the fact that two criminal cases were registered on 22.02.2024 and 11.05.2024 regarding the same victim and accused/applicant and the victim has not supported the prosecution case.
On that basis, without commenting anything on merits of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

sentences.text: It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial, however, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective.
